# Missa

> Missa is a free site where artists and writers find open calls, grants, residencies, magazines and prizes, see the fee, who can apply and the official page for each, and get reminded before they close. Organizations can post calls and take submissions through Missa. The public catalog, directory and rankings are open to everyone.

## Public pages

- [Browse open calls](https://www.usemissa.com/opportunities): open calls, grants, residencies, fellowships, contests, prizes, exhibitions and festivals.
- [Directory](https://www.usemissa.com/directory): residencies, literary journals, small presses, grant foundations and arts organizations.
- [Manuscript matcher](https://www.usemissa.com/discover/match): literary magazines that publish work like yours.
- [Magazine rankings](https://www.usemissa.com/rankings/magazines): the 2026 Missa literary magazine index.
- [Residency rankings](https://www.usemissa.com/rankings/residencies): artist residencies and fellowships ranked on funding, facilities and evidence.
- [How Missa works](https://www.usemissa.com/methodology): how Missa separates facts, scores and official sources.
- [About Missa](https://www.usemissa.com/about): what Missa is building and why.
- [Privacy](https://www.usemissa.com/privacy) and [Terms](https://www.usemissa.com/terms): the public privacy notice and terms.

## What Missa helps with

- Find open calls, grants, residencies, fellowships, contests, magazines, commissions and awards for the work you make.
- Check the deadline, fee, who can apply, location, what to send and the organizer's own page.
- Save calls, get reminded two weeks, a week, three days and a day before they close, and keep track of what you sent.
- Bring an existing submissions spreadsheet into the Tracker.

## Evidence and trust

- Missa keeps the official source close to the opportunity.
- Missa labels information that is unknown or conflicting.
- Missa does not silently fill in missing facts.
- The official host remains the authority for current requirements and applications.
- Saving an opportunity is not an application, and does not confirm eligibility.

## Machine-readable discovery

- [Robots policy](https://www.usemissa.com/robots.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://www.usemissa.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Opportunity JSON API](https://www.usemissa.com/api/opportunities)
